propositions: Blocking link events written before comparability became structural remain incorrect on disk because LINK events are durable and not re-resolved on read, causing ancestor-blocking and mis-escalated edges to distort ready/next-batch and parent-first cascade.

rebar doctor scans active blocking edges, classifies findings (ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, unreadable), and with --repair rewrites stale edges while respecting guards: replacement written before unlink, no cross-item lock, pre-doctor-repair tag as rollback anchor, refusal during reconciler pass, and declining ambiguous pairs.

Repair must not hold the tracker write lock across the loop because the lock is non-re-entrant and every inner write acquisition blocks on the outer hold, causing 60s timeouts; fix is to acquire lock per write only.
A mis-escalated edge whose resolved source is closed cannot be repaired because add_dependency refuses a link whose source is closed, making such edges inert for scheduling despite remaining on disk.
